data.description:
## Description

**What**: Adopt the new Semgrep gate in the DSO repo's own `.github/workflows/ci.yml` during this sprint, mirroring `examples/ci.example.yml`, and produce evidence that at least one sprint PR triggers a successful Semgrep job.

**Why**: SC-6 is an explicit self-use (Probe-1) dogfood probe — evidence that the template we ship actually runs in a real repository. None of the other stories touch the DSO repo's own workflow file; they target the template under `examples/`. Without this story, SC-6 has no DD owner and the completion-verifier cannot confirm dogfood.

**Scope**:
- IN: Replace any existing Bandit step in .github/workflows/ci.yml; add Semgrep job using pinned container tag from sc-1; ensure --metrics=off; mandatory + DSO-relevant rulesets (mandatory at minimum, plus p/python if detect-stack flags Python tooling); confirm via SC-6 verification commands at sprint Phase I
- OUT: Changing the template under examples/ (owned by 4c44-9805); adding new rulesets beyond what 58bf-f9bb produces

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, .github/workflows/ci.yml of the DSO repo includes a Semgrep job that uses the same pinned `semgrep/semgrep` Docker container tag as examples/ci.example.yml with --metrics=off, and `grep -n 'semgrep' .github/workflows/ci.yml` returns ≥1 hit referencing the pinned container tag
  ← Satisfies: sc-6  (sc-6: "self-use Probe-1: DSO repo's own ci.yml adopts the Semgrep gate mirroring examples/ci.example.yml")
- When this story is complete, at least one PR opened during this sprint (epic 6add-c1fc) triggers a Semgrep job whose conclusion is `success`, verified by `gh run list --workflow=ci.yml --branch=<sprint-branch> --json conclusion,jobs | jq '.[].jobs[] | select(.name | test(\"[Ss]emgrep\")) | .conclusion'`
  ← Satisfies: sc-6  (sc-6: "at least one sprint PR triggers a successful Semgrep job — verified by gh run list filter")
- When this story is complete, any pre-existing Bandit step in .github/workflows/ci.yml is removed in the same change so Semgrep is the sole SAST gate
  ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Sequencing] This story must be implemented AFTER 58bf-f9bb (script exists), 4c44-9805 (template pattern exists to mirror), and the fail_on/decoupling story (invariants pinned) so the DSO repo adopts the final form, not an intermediate one
- [Self-host] The DSO repo's stack is bash + Python tooling; the .semgrep.yml generated here should at minimum include mandatory rulesets and, if detect-stack identifies python-poetry tooling, p/python
- [Evidence] The success-run evidence must come from a sprint-branch PR, not a post-merge run; the verification command in SC-6 filters by --branch=<sprint-branch>
- [Risk] If Semgrep flags pre-existing findings in the DSO codebase, that is in-scope to triage — either fix, suppress with documented rationale, or raise fail_on appropriately. Do not weaken the global gate to make this story pass; surface findings as bug tickets

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer of the DSO project, our own CI pipeline runs the new Semgrep gate (self-use Probe-1)
